author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**

PAINT issue: UniProtKB:Q8N954	GPATCH11	is_active_in	GO:0000776    kinetochore	ECO:0000318   IBA	GO_REF:0000033	 PANTHER:PTN000471210 

derived from

UniProtKB:Q8N954 | GPATCH11 | located_in | GO:0000776    kinetochore | ECO:0000314   IDA | PMID:20813266

I think this is incorrect- the image is quite low resolution. A more recent, in-depth, specific but uncurated paper identifies a  nuclear and centrosome location, and a splicing role (some splicing components do localise to the centrosome), but explicitly does not observe kinetochore localisation.

https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39572588/
Nat Commun
. 2024 Nov 21;15(1):10096. doi: 10.1038/s41467-024-54549-8.
GPATCH11 variants cause mis-splicing and early-onset retinal dystrophy with neurological impairment

and a new pombe paper confirms the splicing role for the fission yeast ortholog
[GPATCH11 ortholog Sap34 regulates pre-mRNA splicing by interacting with early spliceosomal complexes in Schizosaccharomyces pombe.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42260140/)
Cipakova I, Karika LO, Hronska L, Selicky T, Iaparov B, Karhanek M, Kohutova L, Barath P, Cipak L.
Sci Rep. 2026 Jun 8. doi: 10.1038/s41598-026-57150-9. Online ahead of print.
PMID: 42260140 F

this will be curated soon , hopefully enabling the splicing role to be propagated via PAINT

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue: UniProtKB:Q8N954	GPATCH11	is_active_in	GO:0000776    kinetochore	ECO:0000318   IBA	GO_REF:0000033	 PANTHER:PTN000471210

author: marcfeuermann
body: Hi Val, in the frame of the gap fill project, I've reviewed this family recently (end of February) and I've added a RNA splicing BP from PMID:39572588. So no rush, we have already the annotation. I've removed the kinetochore stuff.
